{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun threads''' were long strands woven into the [[duracord]] netting of a [[Stun net/Legends|stun net]]. Alongside [[stun bead]]s, the threads conducted the [[stun field]] generated by the stun net, allowing the device to shock and paralyze anything caught within the net.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
